cornerstone.holders: Junshi Hong Kong Limited; Sanjin International Co., Ltd.; Guohui HK (Guohui (HK) Holdings Co., Limited); CHIL; WuXi Biologics Venture (WuXi Biologics HealthCare Venture); Zhonghe Capital
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; frees up on the six-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Investor names from the cornerstone table on p.266.

controller_6m.full_quote: (a) at any time in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of their shareholdings in our Company is made in this Prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of any Shares in respect of which our Controlling Shareholders are shown in this Prospectus to be the beneficial owners
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07 undertaking: period ending ON the date which is six months from the Listing Date; inclusive endpoint, first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) at any time in the period of six months commencing from the date on which the period referred to in the above paragraph (a) expires, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of any Shares to such extent that, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, our Controlling Shareholders will, directly or indirectly cease to be our Controlling Shareholders
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b)-style undertaking: second six-month period commencing on expiry of the first (six months from the Listing Date); frees up on the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date
controller_12m.notes: Conditional on ceasing to be Controlling Shareholders; effective control maintenance = 12 months from Listing Date.
